# Offline QR encoder

Project Nayuki, QR Code generator v1.8.0 (MIT).
Source: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/blob/v1.8.0/typescript-javascript/qrcodegen.ts

`qrcodegen.ts` is the unmodified upstream source. `qrcodegen.js` was generated using Node.js 22.22.3 `node:module.stripTypeScriptTypes(source, {mode: "transform"})`. The upstream MIT header is prepended to the generated JavaScript. Both files retain the MIT notice. No package or network access is required at runtime.
